_comment: Template for the scrubbable photo sequence. Copy to sequence.json, drop the photos in public/images/sequence/, and the band appears on /story between chapter five and the trajectory band. Delete sequence.json and the band disappears — nothing else needs touching. `aspect` is portrait | landscape | square and crops every frame to the same box, so shoot or pick frames from a consistent vantage. `label` is the short tick under the scrubber; `caption` swaps as the reader drags.
title: One spot on the lease, four visits
intro: Same coordinates, same heading, four trips across a year. Nothing between these frames but the reef doing its own work.

frames.alt: Bare mud bottom on the lease before any cultch was placed
frames.label: Apr 2025
frames.caption: Before the work: bare bottom, nothing for a larva to hold.

frames.alt: Freshly placed limestone and river rock on the lease bottom
frames.label: Jun 2025
frames.caption: Days after bedding. Clean rock, no growth on it yet.

frames.alt: Young oyster spat cemented onto placed rock
frames.label: Sep 2025
frames.caption: First set. Spat cemented to the rock and starting to build shell.

frames.alt: Clustered live oysters covering the placed cultch
frames.label: Dec 2025
frames.caption: Six months on: clusters closed over the rock. This is what the resurvey read as solid reef.
